title: Auto-Tune Policy: secure approval, role gating, and immutable audit trail for automated batching/cache changes
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a compliance-first workflow for Redwood's auto-apply cost optimizations (batching and KV/prefix caching recommendations) so automated configuration changes can be applied safely in production and rolled back with a fully auditable trail. Scope includes RBAC for who can opt-in/authorize automated applies, an approval/escrow step for high-impact changes, deterministic rollback primitives, immutable audit events that capture pre/post config states, and retention/exports for SOC2/Audit requests.

Acceptance criteria (high-level):
- RBAC controls: new granular roles (AutoApplyAdmin, AutoApplyApprover, AutoApplyObserver) mapped to SSO groups; APIs verify role before auto-apply.
- Change gating: automated suggestions are tagged by impact score; anything above threshold requires explicit approver action or scheduled canary windows.
- Immutable audit log: every automated apply/rollback emits an append-only event (timestamped, user/service principal, diff, commit SHA, evaluation metrics) stored for minimum 1 year and exportable.
- Safe rollback: every applied change associates a rollback job that can restore prior config atomically and triggers regression checks. Rollbacks are rate-limited and require approver for cross-region or customer-impacting failures.
- Operational runbook: documented playbook for manual overrides, emergency rollback, and postmortem artifacts.
- Tests: integration tests that simulate failing canary and verify automatic rollback path.

Non-goals: policy authoring UI redesign, deep ML model changes (those are covered by model-rollout flows), and billing-level price adjustments outside inference config scope.
comments: 2026-02-21: Initial scoping meeting with Security (Priya), PM (Jordan), and Runtime team. Agreed to prioritize audit immutability and RBAC mapping to SSO.
2026-02-28: Design doc uploaded. Security requested cryptographic signing of critical audit events and HSM-backed key usage for high-impact applies.
2026-03-03: Eng design review: proposed role names and API changes (POST /autotune/apply -> requires 'approver' header or token). Marcus volunteered to prototype the audit event schema.
2026-03-07: Prototype PR for append-only audit store posted (see linked_prs). Initial retention policy set to 1 year; compliance asked for configurable retention per customer tier.
2026-03-10: PM asked to add 'canary window' as an approval option and a matrix for impact thresholds per model family. Security added a checklist for KMS/HSM integration and key rotation cadence.
decisions: Use append-only event store (immutable S3 prefix + Dynamo index) with SHA256 digests and signing via KMS/HSM for high-impact events.

Three RBAC roles approved: AutoApplyAdmin (configure policies), AutoApplyApprover (approve high-impact applies), AutoApplyObserver (view-only audit). These map to SSO groups managed by Customer IAM teams.
Impact scoring will be computed from a mix of expected cost delta, latency SLO risk, and customer tag. Threshold > medium requires explicit approver or scheduled canary.
